title: Arrabbiata Orzo Soup
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon pepper, plus extra to serve
TO SERVE: basil leaves, Parmesan-style vegetarian cheese grated
method: Put the garlic, chilli and tomatoes in a food processor and whizz until completely smooth.
Pour the tomato mixture into a large saucepan, add the vegetable stock, salt and pepper and bring up to a fast simmer.
Add the orzo and simmer for 15-20 minutes until the orzo is cooked through, stirring regularly to ensure it doesn't stick.
Serve with basil leaves, a scattering of grated cheese and a few grinds of black pepper.
notes: If too thick, add extra vegetable stock or cook the orzo separately. Blend fresh herbs (basil, oregano or parsley) into the tomato sauce for extra herby flavour.
